content: Downstream validation-set $F_1$ on fine-grained NER, reported in Table TABREF21, shows that the end-to-end strategy lags behind the others, perhaps indicating the need to train longer than 10 epochs. However, a single epoch on the 1B-word benchmark takes 36 hours on 2 Tesla V100s, making this prohibitive. Interestingly, the frozen strategy, which takes the least amount of time to converge (24 hours on 1 Tesla V100), also performs almost as well as fine-tuning.
